sections.text: # About Us
Our Professional Team

Behind SDG Railway is a team of experts dedicated to ensuring efficient, safe, and sustainable freight operations. Each department combines experience, innovation, and commitment to deliver high-quality intermodal transport solutions.

Mission Statement – What drives us

At SDG Railway, our mission is to redefine the future of freight transport by combining the efficiency of rail logistics with the power of digital innovation and sustainability.

We are driven by the belief that smarter, cleaner transport is not only possible — it’s essential.

Through technology, collaboration, and continuous improvement, we aim to deliver solutions that reduce environmental impact, enhance operational performance, and strengthen intermodal connectivity.

Our commitment goes beyond moving goods — we move progress.

By integrating advanced digital tools, real-time visibility, and energy-efficient operations, SDG Railway contributes to building greener supply chains and a more sustainable logistics industry for generations to come.

Vision – Where we are going

Our vision is to become a leading force in the European intermodal network, setting new standards for sustainable and intelligent rail freight operations.

We aspire to bridge the gap between ports, terminals, and industries through seamless digital integration and environmentally responsible practices.

As part of the Port Virtual Lab ecosystem, SDG Railway aims to inspire innovation and collaboration among logistics professionals, fostering a culture of continuous learning and improvement.

Our Role in the PVL Ecosystem

SDG Railway operates within the Port Virtual Lab, a digital learning and simulation platform for logistics, transport, and international trade. Through interactive case studies, users can plan rail operations, compare intermodal routes, and experience the decision-making process of real freight companies.
Compliance & Commitment

We operate under the highest European standards of safety, quality, and sustainability.

Our commitment to compliance goes beyond meeting legal obligations — it defines the way we deliver reliable, transparent, and environmentally responsible rail freight solutions.

We strictly adhere to the Regulations concerning the International Carriage of Dangerous Goods by Rail (RID), the European Green Deal objectives, and the ISO 9001 and ISO 14001 management frameworks.

Our operational procedures are audited regularly to ensure alignment with these international standards.

Every activity, from loading to dispatch, follows a clear compliance protocol that includes:

Continuous monitoring of safety and environmental performance.

Training and certification of all staff involved in intermodal operations.

Implementation of digital traceability systems through our ERP for full data transparency.

Collaboration with trusted partners who share our sustainability and compliance values.

At SDG Railway, compliance is not just a requirement — it is a strategic value that drives operational excellence and builds trust with our partners across Europe.

Your Trusted Partner in Sustainable Rail Freight

SDG Railway provides logistics operators, freight forwarders, and shippers with efficient and sustainable rail transport solutions connecting major ports and inland terminals across Europe. Through its digital management platform, users can plan routes, request quotes, and coordinate intermodal shipments seamlessly.

Unlike traditional rail freight services, SDG Railway operates within a fully integrated digital environment, combining real-time visibility, optimized scheduling, and environmental impact tracking. Each service is designed to reduce transit times, minimize emissions, and enhance transparency across the supply chain.

With SDG Railway, customers gain access to door-to-terminal and port-to-inland connections, supported by advanced ERP integration and automated documentation tools.
Key Values

Efficiency

Optimized routes, advanced scheduling, and seamless intermodal coordination ensure that every shipment moves on time and cost-effectively. We are committed to delivering reliable freight services that maximize performance and minimize delays.

Sustainability

Powered by electric locomotives and driven by environmental responsibility, we significantly reduce carbon emissions compared to road transport. Each journey contributes to a cleaner, greener logistics network across Europe.

Digital Innovation

Through smart digital tools and real-time data integration, we enhance transparency, traceability, and decision-making. Innovation is at the core of every operation, creating a more connected and intelligent supply chain.

# Railway Dashboard

Railway inland transport is one of the smartest ways to move cargo across a continent.

Freight trains can replace dozens of trucks in a single movement, offering lower CO₂ emissions, reduced noise and far less congestion on roads. Along major European rail corridors, inland rail provides high capacity, reliable transit times and competitive costs, especially when integrated with ports, terminals and last-mile road transport in truly multimodal supply chains.

For students, understanding inland rail transport means learning how to design efficient and sustainable logistics solutions, where choices about routes, terminals, train types and intermodal connections directly impact cost, lead time and environmental performance of international trade operations.

# Services
Gate In Procedures

At the origin terminal, all Loading Units undergo an inspection before entry into the rail terminal area.

During Gate In, SDG Railway staff and the Terminal Operator verify:

Documentation accuracy (booking reference, consignment note, and dangerous goods declaration if applicable).

Condition and identification of the Loading Unit (container, swap body, or trailer).

Compliance with safety and weight standards prior to train allocation.

Once verified, the unit is registered in SDG Railway’s digital system and assigned to a railcar for loading.

The timestamp of Gate In marks the start of operational responsibility under SDG Railway’s custody.
Gate Out Procedures

At the destination terminal, Loading Units are unloaded and inspected prior to release.

During Gate Out, the Terminal Operator and customer representative confirm:

Integrity and sealing of the unit.

Absence of visible damage or irregularities.

Delivery documentation signed and validated (Interchange report or electronic acknowledgment).

The Gate Out timestamp concludes the responsibility of SDG Railway for that shipment.

title: SDG Railway - Container and Trailer Packing

sections.text: # Container and Trailer Packing

Our container and trailer packing operations follow strict intermodal safety standards to ensure secure, efficient, and traceable handling of all cargo.

Our loading processes comply with European railway regulations (UIC, EN 12195, and RID), and are designed to optimize both stability and sustainability across every journey.
Pre-Loading Inspection

Before each unit is loaded:

The container or semi-trailer is checked for structural integrity and cleanliness.

Weight and Verified Gross Mass (VGM) are confirmed according to SOLAS regulations.

Dangerous goods, if applicable, are verified according to RID classification and documentation.

Every inspection is digitally logged through SDG Railway’s Operational ERP, ensuring full traceability and compliance.
Loading Process

##

Containerized cargo

Containers are handled using gantry cranes or reach stackers in accordance with UIC 592 standards. Each unit is lifted vertically and placed precisely on the wagon’s twist locks, ensuring full alignment.

Operators verify that all four corners are securely locked before train dispatch. This process is mainly used for 20’, 40’, and 45’ containers and ensures maximum accuracy and efficiency in intermodal handling.

##

Pocket Wagon System -T3000e System

Semi-trailers compliant with the P400 profile are loaded vertically onto pocket wagons (type T3000e) using a Lift-on/Lift-off (Lo-Lo) system.

The trailer is lifted by crane and positioned so that the wheels rest in the wagon’s lower pockets, while the kingpin is locked into a front support mechanism.

This unaccompanied intermodal loading method allows only the trailer to travel by rail, while the tractor unit and driver remain at the terminal. The system ensures efficient terminal operations, safe load securing, and full compatibility across European intermodal rail corridors.

##

Swap bodies

The swap body is lifted from the truck chassis and carefully positioned onto dedicated wagon supports, which are designed to accommodate its foldable legs and structural frame. Once in place, the unit is secured using locking and support systems that ensure stability during rail transport.

This Lift-on/Lift-off (Lo-Lo) loading method enables efficient and flexible unaccompanied intermodal transport, allowing the swap body to move independently of the road vehicle. The system ensures fast terminal operations, optimal weight distribution, and high compatibility with European rail networks and intermodal corridors.

##

Vehicles (Car Transport)

Vehicles are loaded onto specialized rail wagons (autorack wagons) using a Roll-on/Roll-off (Ro-Ro) system.

Cars, vans, or light commercial vehicles are driven directly onto the wagons via ramps, where they are positioned on single or multi-level decks. Once in place, the vehicles are secured using wheel chocks and lashing systems to prevent movement during rail transport.

This Ro-Ro loading method enables fast and efficient terminal operations, minimizes handling risks, and is widely used in the automotive industry for large-scale vehicle distribution across European rail corridors.

##

Rolling Highway

The Rolling Highway (Ro-La) system allows complete trucks—tractor unit and semi-trailer—to be loaded horizontally onto low-floor rail wagons using a Roll-on/Roll-off (Ro-Ro) method.

The driver steers the truck onto the train via a ramp, and the vehicle is secured on specially designed wagons with very low deck heights.

This system enables accompanied or semi-accompanied intermodal transport, as drivers may travel with the train or return separately. Ro-La is mainly used on environmentally sensitive corridors, such as Alpine routes, to reduce road congestion, emissions, and driving restrictions while ensuring seamless cross-border freight movement.
Weight Distribution & Safety

Cargo must be evenly distributed to maintain wagon balance and safe braking performance.

Heavy containers are placed toward the center of the train; lighter units are arranged on the outer wagons.

Load securing follows EN 12195-1 (Lashing & Securing of Cargo) standards, guaranteeing optimal safety during rail transport.

To reinforce compliance and packaging efficiency, SDG Railway collaborates with PlayPackaging, our trusted partner specialized in sustainable and certified cargo packaging solutions designed for intermodal transport.

Our digital Load Planner Tool automatically verifies axle load limits and overall stability before train departure, optimizing operational reliability and environmental performance.
Securing the Load
All units are secured using:

Twist locks

Kingpin locks

Additional lashings

Anti-slip mats and shock absorbers

# Dangerous Goods

SDG RAILWAY practices its own reliable Dangerous Goods Teams. Our regions of Europe and Mediterranean, all have their own handling procedures for DG application and approval procedures.

Our DG coordinators offer shippers all the advice that is required. A shipper's or customer's Dangerous Goods cargo will be checked promptly and accurately. Legal requirements concerning all the countries/regions, terminals and ports related to transport are taken into account.

In addition, SDG RAILWAY ensures safe transport by observing the relevant stowage and segregation requirements of dangerous goods. This gives additional safety to the cargo, the train, the crew, cargo handlers and the overall environment. SDG RAILWAY's DG teams are also available to discuss all issues regarding the different international and domestic regulations and help customers find solutions for special arrangements and exemptions via our relations to the transport authorities in countries/regions around the world.

SDG RAILWAY follow the regulations establish by the Intergovernmental Organisation for International Carriage by Rail (OTIF) www.otif.org

# Railway Equipment Fleet
Intermodal Transport Units (ITUs)

At SDG Railway, we operate with a modern and versatile range of Intermodal Transport Units (ITUs) — standardized equipment designed to carry cargo seamlessly across rail, road, and maritime networks without direct handling of the goods.

These units ensure operational flexibility, faster transfers, and full compatibility with European intermodal terminals and rolling stock such as the T3000e double pocket wagons.

EURODUAL

BI-MODE LOCOMOTIVE
A vehicle at the avant-garde of technology that covers every need in an efficient and reliable way, offering rail operators numerous economic and ecological benefits.

Vehicle data

Locomotive type: Bi-mode (Electric/Diesel-electric).

Track gauge: 1,435 mm / 1,668 mm

Axle arrangement: Co’Co’

Supply voltage: 1.5 kV DC / 3 kV DC /

Electric power: 15 kV AC / 25 kV AC

Diesel power: Up to 7,000 kW

Starting tractive effort: Up to 2,800 kW

Fuel tank: Up to 500 kN

Transmission: Up to 4,000 l

Maximum speed: AC/AC

Brake system:

Up to 160 km/h

Mechanic: Pneumatic

Dynamic: Regenerative/rheostatic

2 distributors, one per bogie

Suspension:

Primary: Coil springs

Secondary: Rubber metal

Vertical and horizontal dampers

Technical features

The EURODUAL is more than just a «last mile» locomotive. It offers two solutions in one. The versatile locomotive can be used on freight and passenger main lines, at speeds of up to 160 km/h, and on electrified and non-electrified lines. The EURODUAL is a six-axle locomotive with AC/AC transmission and low axle-load based on service-proven components and subsystems. It has been designed with a high degree of redundancy, which increases availability. Available in different gauges and overhead

voltages (1.5 kV DC, 3 kV DC, 15 kV AC, 25 kV AC).

# Our Locomotive Models

At SDG Railway, each locomotive represents more than technology; it embodies a virtue. Inspired by the Greek concept of Areté, the pursuit of excellence, our fleet unites courage, balance, and justice in motion.

##

ANDREIA - Courage

E-PRS 9 5 71 0 201 501 4

According to Hippia of Élide, the purpose of the teaching was to achieve Areté, which means training to think, to speak and to act successfully. The political ("civic") excellence of the Greeks consisted in the cultivation of three specific virtues: andreia (courage), sofrosine (moderation or balance) and dicaiosine (justice): these virtues formed a relevant, useful and perfect citizen. To these virtues Plato then added a fourth, Prudence, giving rise to the so-called Cardinal Virtues: prudence, strength and temperance would correspond to the three parts of the soul, and harmony between them would engender the fourth, justice.

##

SOFROSINE - Balance

E-PRS 9 5 71 0 201 502 2

In a way, the Greek earring would be equivalent to the Roman virtus, dignity, honour or manhood of good.Towards the classical period - above all the 5th and 4th centuries BC - the meaning of Areté approached what is today considered "virtue", fundamentally through the work of Aristotle, in general, including features such as μεγαλοψυχια (megalopsyjía, 'magnanimity'), σοφροσυνη (sofrosine, 'temperance') or δικαιοσυνη (dicaiosine, 'justice').

##

DICAIOSINE - Justice

E-PRS 9 5 71 0 201 503 0

The acquisition of the earring was the pivotal point in the education (παιδεία, paideía) of the young Greek to become a citizen, following the ideal set out by Isocrates.

Traces of the more restricted conception of the archaic era can be seen in the emphasis placed on discipline and mastery of the body through gymnastics, one of the main activities, and fighting, but a finished education also included the arts of oratory, music and - eventually - philosophy.

##

PR FARFALLA – Transformation

E-PRS 9 5 71 0 301 601 0

Represents the adaptability and transformation of modern logistics. Much like a butterfly emerging from its chrysalis, this locomotive embodies efficiency and sustainability evolving together. Its lightweight structure and dual-power system allow it to operate seamlessly across electrified and non-electrified routes, ensuring flexibility where others stop.

##

PR SPERANZA – Hope

E-PRS 9 5 71 0 301 602 0

Carries the spirit of renewal and endurance. Designed for long-haul freight, its bi-mode propulsion ensures continuous motion, even in the face of challenges.

It is the locomotive of perseverance, connecting regions and industries with reliability and optimism.

In the tradition of SDG Railway, “Speranza” is not only a machine but a message: that sustainable mobility is the hope of future generations.

##

PR PHRONESIS – Wisdom

E-PRS 9 5 71 0 301 603 0

Inspired by the Greek concept of practical wisdom, represents intelligent transport management. Equipped with advanced digital control systems and real-time diagnostics, it optimizes energy use and maintenance cycles.

It embodies thoughtful engineering, where precision meets purpose.

Every journey it leads is guided by logic, data, and responsibility.

##

PR VELOCE – Speed

E-PRS 9 5 71 0 301 604 0

PR Veloce is the expression of velocity and performance. Built for rapid intermodal transport, it combines aerodynamic design with a power output capable of handling Europe’s busiest freight corridors.

Its refined traction and regenerative braking systems deliver both speed and sustainability, proving that progress can move fast, yet stay balanced.

It is the emblem of SDG Railway’s commitment to smart, swift, and sustainable logistics.

##

ATR EXPRESS – The Desert Pulse

E-PRS 9 5 71 0 401 701 0

ATR Express is built to endure the demanding conditions of the Egyptian rail network, from the coastal humidity of Alexandria to the heat of the inland routes.

Its dual traction system ensures constant efficiency under extreme temperatures, while its reinforced suspension and high-capacity cooling systems make it ideal for heavy freight and long-distance operations.

Like the Nile that sustains life through balance, ATR Express embodies the rhythm of endurance, carrying the pulse of Egypt’s industrial growth

##

CHEMAAL EXPRESS – The Horizon Line

E-PRS 9 5 71 0 401 702 0

Chemaal Express takes its name from the Arabic word “شمال” (chemaal, meaning north), symbolizing guidance and direction.

It is a locomotive designed for reliability across Egypt’s northern corridors, linking the ports of the Mediterranean with inland logistics centers.

With its bi-mode power and optimized traction for sandy terrains, it demonstrates how technology adapts to geography.

Chemaal Express embodies the spirit of progress, always moving forward and always looking towards the horizon.

##

CERISE EXPRESS – The Pulse of Precision

E-PRS 9 5 71 0 501 801 0

Cerise Express captures the strength and refinement of modern French engineering.

Named after the vibrant cherry (cerise), a symbol of energy and renewal, this locomotive embodies the harmony between speed and precision.

Equipped with a cutting-edge traction control system and real-time performance monitoring, it ensures seamless operation on both regional and international corridors.

Its bi-mode configuration allows effortless transition from electric to diesel, maintaining optimal performance even beyond electrified lines.

##

CHOU EXPRESS – The Strength of Harmony

E-PRS 9 5 71 0 501 802 0

Chou Express reflects endurance, adaptability, and sustainability, qualities deeply rooted in SDG Railway’s philosophy.

Its name (chou, meaning cabbage) may seem humble, but it symbolizes layered strength and nourishment, just like a robust logistics system that supports economies from within.

This locomotive is optimized for heavy freight along the Mediterranean and Atlantic branches, featuring enhanced regenerative braking and an aerodynamic frame for lower energy consumption.

Chou Express proves that durability and environmental care can coexist.

##

PR AL-QITAAR – The Spirit of the Desert Line

E-PRS 9 5 71 0 601 901 0

PR Al-Qitaar takes its name from the Arabic word القطار (al-qitaar, “the train”), evoking the legacy of movement across the ancient trade routes that once connected the Arabian deserts to the Mediterranean.

Built to endure long hauls under extreme temperatures, this locomotive symbolizes resilience and continuity.

Its bi-mode propulsion ensures reliable operation across mixed electrified and non-electrified tracks, while advanced sand-filtration systems and adaptive cooling keep performance steady in desert conditions.

Al-Qitaar represents the union of tradition and technology.
